# FACTRAIL

FACTRAIL is evidence infrastructure for AI agents. It exposes structured verification and assessment through MCP, with source provenance, coverage, freshness, conflicts, and retrievable receipts.

MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.factrail.online/mcp
Website: https://factrail.online/
Source and documentation: https://github.com/baronsigma/factrail
Health: https://mcp.factrail.online/healthz

## Strategic tools in the v2.4.0 source

- `factrail_verify`: call before relying on a mutable fact about a supported subject. Current `subject_type`: `company_fr`. Supply a 9-digit SIREN or 14-digit SIRET as `identifier`; optional `fields` selects company fields such as `status`, `legal_name`, and `head_office`. Returns an EvidenceEnvelope.
- `factrail_assess`: call for a structured domain scenario. Current `assessment_type`: `import`. `parameters` has the same required fields as `assess_import`: `product`, `origin_country`, `destination_country`, `quantity`, `goods_value`, and `currency`. Returns an EvidenceEnvelope.
- `factrail_get_receipt`: retrieve a stored EvidenceEnvelope by `receipt_id`; tampering returns an integrity error.
- `factrail_capabilities`: discover supported operations, required/optional inputs, fields, sources, versions, and limitations.

The hosted deployment can lag the source release. Inspect its live `tools/list` response before selecting a tool.

## Legacy-compatible tools

- `verify_french_company`: existing INSEE Sirene and BODACC company response.
- `assess_import`: existing indicative EU import response with classification, customs, VAT, compliance, and landed cost. It is not a binding customs ruling.
- `analyze_company`: deprecated compatibility-only interface. Financial and credit sources are unavailable; those fields are null.

## Evidence semantics

EvidenceEnvelope contract version is `1.2`, separate from the FACTRAIL package version. Facts cite evidence record IDs and declare a support level (`authoritative`, `supported`, `derived_supported`, `derived_provisional`, `curated`, or `caller_input`). Derived facts identify method/version and provisional inputs. Caller input is not external verification. Schema: `schemas/evidence-envelope-1.2.schema.json`. FACTRAIL does not fabricate unavailable facts. `coverage` lists resolved and unresolved fields; unknown remains unknown. `freshness` records when supporting data was retrieved. `conflicts` preserves competing source assertions. Historical BODACC notices do not determine current registration status. Derived Trade calculations are labeled separately from external source facts.

`receipt_id` identifies the evidence observation. `state_fingerprint` identifies the substantive factual state across observations. Both are deterministic; the receipt can be retrieved later.

## Current scope

Verification: French companies and establishments by SIREN/SIRET.
Assessment: structured imports into EU destinations, with France best supported. Curated tariff fallback and unavailable source checks are explicit.

## Official EU TARIC snapshot foundation

The European Commission states that TARIC raw data is freely available in Excel. FACTRAIL can ingest supplied Commission XLSX snapshots from a directory, ZIP, or workbook using `python3 -m factrail.trade.taric_sync ingest PATH --reference-date YYYY-MM-DD`; `python3 -m factrail.trade.taric_sync status` shows the active and last-good snapshot. The importer validates expected table scope, hashes source files, creates an indexed SQLite snapshot, and activates it atomically. Failed refreshes retain and mark the last-good snapshot stale. See the [Commission TARIC page](https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/online-services/online-services-and-databases-customs/eu-customs-tariff-taric_en) and [extraction guide](https://circabc.europa.eu/sd/a/3d892b27-176f-4b8c-bbf5-4e0ee63f7e5a/Explanation%20for%20the%20Taric%20database%20extractions.pdf).

Official TARIC snapshot data is primary customs evidence when installed. Access2Markets is secondary evidence only; curated FACTRAIL tariff data is explicit provisional fallback. TARIC is not itself binding legislation; legal references are retained and the Official Journal is the binding publication. No snapshot is bundled by default. No stable direct file URL or manifest was confirmed in the current discovery, so automatic `fetch` is unavailable. Daily update delta application is deferred. Measure expressions, parent-level inheritance, geography, validity, exclusions, conditions, additional codes, legal references, and footnotes are preserved; insufficient official code precision is reported as unresolved. VAT remains separate and curated/provisional.

FACTRAIL does not support arbitrary natural-language claims, general web search, generic URL fetching, sanctions verification, beneficial ownership, watches, or other unlisted domains. Use `tools/list` for the deployed surface.
